method: Each game ran through the native display loop for 10 seconds after 720 warm-up emulated frames. Start was held on frames 400-409 and A on 700-709. Display FPS is the final one-second counter, while emulated FPS covers the full measured interval. Three framebuffer captures passed byte count and SHA-256 verification. These are short scripted checks, not full playthroughs or a battery-runtime test.
controller_manual_test: Owner confirmed opening a game with A/Start, directional controls, holding Start + Select for 700 ms to pause, returning to the game library, and the display.
